alate: Body uniformly dark brown, head capsule darker, postclypeus yellow to yellowish brown, with a pale yellow stripe between the ocelli; pronotum with a pale T marking; legs yellow. Body length with wings 7.49 to 9.44 mm, body length 5.55 to 5.89 mm. Head capsule elliptical, slightly longer than wide, length 0.84 to 0.87 mm, width 0.74 to 0.80 mm; fontanelle a small dot, the coronal suture faintly visible. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 shortest. The distance between the compound eyes and the ventral margin of the head about one quarter of their long diameter. Ocelli oval, about 0.10 mm long, their distance to the compound eyes less than half their long diameter. Postclypeus slightly arched, median length 0.22 to 0.23 mm, width 0.37 to 0.40 mm. Pronotum trapezoidal, length 0.38 to 0.46 mm, width 0.62 to 0.74 mm, the anterior margin slightly tilted up and shallowly concave in the middle, the posterior margin distinctly concave. Hind tibia 0.94 to 1.02 mm long.
biology: It builds globular nests on the ground more than 1 m across, bores mainly into tree stumps, and also attacks timber in dwellings and warehouses, utility poles, railway sleepers and fences; in durability tests of 78 Hainan timbers it appeared late but then nested in the test blocks and damaged Hopea hainanensis, Madhuca hainanensis and Lithocarpus woods severely.
distribution: Yaxian, Dongfang, Ledong and Lingshui, Hainan.
soldier: Head capsule brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellow tinged with brown. A few scattered long hairs borne on the head capsule. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, slightly narrower at the middle, the posterior margin broadly rounded; frontal peaks slightly raised, the frontal surface almost smooth. In lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly concave behind the frons, the top of the frons level with the posterior margin of the head. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest and shorter than segment 2. Labrum flatly square, the anterior margin mostly inclined downwards. Both mandibles sickle-shaped, the tips slender and slightly curved; the serrations of the inner margin of unequal size, the outer margin at the base re-entering at almost a right angle; the middle of the postmentum not markedly convex, the waist region near the posterior margin; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin shallowly concave, the posterior margin straight. Small soldier paler than the large form, head capsule rectangular but shorter, the frontal angles visible, the dorsal margin of the head rather flat; antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest and about half of segment 2; mandibles rather slender and straight, with a coarse tooth on the inner margin near the basal third, tapering forwards; the convexity of the middle of the postmentum also inconspicuous.
